name: tooltip
description: Hover/focus tooltip with aria-describedby association, delay, and Escape dismissal
designIntent: Tooltip provides supplementary context on hover and keyboard focus. It appears with a short delay, is announced via aria-describedby, and dismisses on Escape so it never traps the user.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds

examples.title: Custom placement
examples.code: Docs
examples.description: Tooltip placed to the right with a short delay

antiPatterns.title: Don't put essential information only in a tooltip
antiPatterns.explanation: Tooltips are unavailable on touch devices and to keyboard users in some contexts. Required information must be visible in the UI.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use tooltips for interactive content
antiPatterns.explanation: Tooltip content is not focusable; use a Popover for links or buttons inside the hint.

accessibility.implementation: The tooltip id is linked to the trigger when visible
accessibility.userRequirements: Triggers should have a visible accessible name

accessibility.implementation: Shows on focus as well as hover
Escape hides the tooltip without moving focus
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the trigger focusable after dismissal

guidelines: Write a sentence or a short label
goodExamples: Copies the command to your clipboard

compositionRules.relationship: Wrap icon-only buttons with a Tooltip to name them
